descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: timing / double tap / switching while transcribing.

Bug B09 · S1 · new

Tapping Dictate shows 'Listening…' before the microphone is open; words spoken in that gap are not recorded (a lost 'no' can flip the meaning)

Tickets: TFA-94423 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Was a decision item; reclassified as a bug. The gap was 0.05–0.1 s in the test, longer on a real network Re-test 2026-10-20 on 8b4be94a: changed: Hospital still shows 'Listening…' ~113 ms before the mic is on; Nursing Home not reproduced (TC-23/S10).

Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S10 Live states: talking before ready, two takes in one box, leaving or switching while 'Transcribing…', a second Dictate, double tap, early Stop, rapid cycles

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Dictated numbers (doses, lab values, vital signs) are transcribed exactly: same value, nothing dropped, added or changed. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 3)
  • T6 No dictated fact is silently dropped (Principle 2), including the last words before Stop and the words around an interruption or a recovery. (TFA-94229 R9) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress
  • U8 Dictation never leaves the physician waiting with nothing: a start or finish that fails is retried and then shown as a clear message, and the AI call time is logged separately from the total. (UAT 3.5)
  • T3 Dictation does not crash the tab. (TFA-94423 AC 8)
  • T9 A live session that fails to connect is retried once; one that drops mid-dictation keeps its recording and transcribes it once with whisper-1, the audio is kept until the transcript is in the field, … (TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-94745 AC 6; TFA-94745 Quinn 2026-10-05 comment)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Hospital patients A and B and Nursing Home residents C and D, live engine; the Hospital pre-round box unless a cell names another surface

When (a) The voice starts 0.5 s after the Dictate tap, before ready; (b) H-03 then H-05 as two takes into the same box (also the NH Pre-Round box and NH Encounter); (c) Stop on H-04, open patient B while 'Transcribing…' shows, then come back (also from Hospital Important Points, encounter notes, 'Start bedside recording', …

Then (a) until the session is ready nothing on the surface says 'Listening…' and a wait message is visible, and every word after ready is in the box; (b) both takes present, in order, once each, the first unchanged; (c) H-04 lands once in A's box (or a Recover control there lands it once), B's pre-round box, Important Points and encounter notes hold none of H-04 …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U1 checks per take; T6: no word after ready missing, no take lost or doubled, and nothing written into another patient's, context's or field's box (the test-design 'data from another patient/context' risk); U8: the wait state is visible while words would be lost. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S10 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-23.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Daniela) · environment local · tickets TFA-94423 ready for qa; TFA-94745 ready for qa; TFA-94229 in progress

Tapping Dictate shows 'Listening…' right away while the microphone is still off, so the first words a physician says in the next 0.5–1.5 s are not recorded.

Evidence: allure-results/017198c6…: 11/13 pass. Both pre-round editors show 'Listening…' while the mic is still muted and the Hearing line says 'Preparing dictation…' (Hospital: 56 samples over 1.5 s; NH: 17 samples over 0.4 s). Words said in that gap are not recorded. This is the open TC-23 Q15; a matrix risk predicted it.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.
